decision_rule: Fresh seeds 31+37 (120 tasks). H1 calibration: AUROC of c for "final answer wrong" >= .70 and ECE of the dev-fitted calibrator <= .15. H2 utility: ds3 utility (LAMBDA=1) >= recipe_always + 5 and ds3 wrong answers <= 0.7 x recipe_always wrong answers, with answered share >= .70. H3 abstention precision: of the abstained tasks >= 60 % would have been wrong under recipe_always. H4 kept answers: ds3 correct >= recipe_always correct - 6. DS3_SUPPORTED when H1..H4 all pass, else the failing parts are named. LAMBDA=2 is reported, not judged.
